newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan state airline traffic up 14.4 pct Jan-Apr.
newsitem.headline: Jordan state airline traffic up 14.4 pct Jan-Apr.

text.p: Jordan's state carrier Royal Jordanian saw a 14.4 percent rise in passenger traffic in the first four months of 1997 compared to the same period last year, its planning department said on Monday.
Royal Jordanian carried 449,595 passengers from January to end of April 1997 and passenger seat factor stood at 66.4 percent.
Total cargo during the same four month period rose 20.2 percent to 26,456 tonnes against the same months of last year.
Freight load factor stood at 58.6 percent in the same four-month period. Traffic was markedly higher on the Indian, Middle East Far East, North African and Gulf routes, the airline said.
